tests.procedure: Under strong white light check each received sample container separately in a clean transparent watch glass or glass dish for foreign particles, colour and conformity with the visual specification.

details.reference: Supplier Certificate for Tartrazine Lake; in-house specification

tests.source: Tartrazine Lake__STM Tartrazine Lake new without micro.txt:28

tests.procedure: Heavy metals (as lead, BP limit test): weigh 0.5 g into a microwave vessel, add 9 mL nitric acid and 1 mL hydrogen peroxide, microwave digest, complete to 100 mL with water. Test solution: 12 mL of the prepared aqueous solution + 0.1 mL sodium sulfide solution R1. Reference: 10 mL lead standard solution (stated as 1 ppm Pb) + 0.1 mL sodium sulfide solution R1. Blank: 10 mL water + 0.1 mL sodium sulfide solution R1. Add 2 mL buffer solution pH 3.5 to each, mix immediately, examine after 2 min: any brown colour in the test solution must not be more intense than the reference.

details.digestion: nitric acid 9 mL + hydrogen peroxide 1 mL, microwave
details.reference: BP Appendix VII Limit Tests, Heavy Metals
details.technique: colour comparison (STM); spec sheet says AAS (see openQuestions)

tests.source: Tartrazine Lake__STM Tartrazine Lake new without micro.txt:29

tests.procedure: HCl insoluble matter: weigh about 5.0 g sample (W1); add 10 mL hydrochloric acid and shake; add 50 mL water; weigh the filter paper before drying (W2); filter, wash the residue with water, dry on the filter to constant mass at 100-105 °C in a calibrated oven, cool in desiccator and weigh the filter paper after drying (W3). Formula as written: % = (W3 - W1) / W2 x 100.

details.formula: % = (W3 - W1) / W2 x 100 (as written; labels inconsistent, see openQuestions)
details.reference: Analytical Method Verification Report for Acid Insoluble Substances in Tartrazine Lake

tests.source: Tartrazine Lake__STM Tartrazine Lake new without micro.txt:30

tests.procedure: pH: disperse 2.0 g in 100 mL water; measure with a calibrated pH meter (USP <791>).

details.reference: USP <791> pH; Analytical Method Verification Report for pH in Tartrazine Lake

tests.source: Tartrazine Lake__STM Tartrazine Lake new without micro.txt:31

tests.procedure: Weigh a previously dried and cooled crucible (W0); add 1.000 g sample (W1 = crucible + material); dry in calibrated oven at 110 °C for 2 h, cool in desiccator, weigh (W2); repeat drying to constant weight. % loss on drying = (W1 - W2) / (W1 - W0) x 100.

details.reference: USP <731>; Analytical Method Verification Report for Loss on drying in Tartrazine Lake

tests.source: Tartrazine Lake__STM Tartrazine Lake new without micro.txt:32

tests.procedure: Bulk density: tare an empty dry cylinder; put 10 mL of bulky powder into it; weigh; bulk density = weight / 10 mL.

details.reference: Analytical Method Verification Report for Bulk density in Tartrazine Lake

openQuestions.question: Heavy metals: the prepared standard is 'Standard Lead Solution 10 ppm' (1 mL of stock to 100 mL), but the procedure's reference solution is '10 mL of lead standard solution (1 ppm Pb)'. The concentrations conflict; loaded as written, confirm the standard.
openQuestions.source: Tartrazine Lake__STM Tartrazine Lake new without micro.txt:26; Tartrazine Lake__STM Tartrazine Lake new without micro.txt:29

openQuestions.question: Heavy metals: the spec sheet technique is AAS, but the STM procedure is a colour comparison (BP limit test); loaded as a Qualitative comparison. Confirm the technique.
openQuestions.source: Tartrazine Lake__Specifications sheet Tartrazine Lake.txt:12; Tartrazine Lake__STM Tartrazine Lake new without micro.txt:29

openQuestions.question: HCl insoluble matter: the formula is written as % = (W3 - W1) / W2 x 100, but W2 is defined as the filter paper weight before drying and W1 as the sample weight (5.0 g); the labels do not match the sample-based calculation. Loaded as written; confirm the formula.
openQuestions.source: Tartrazine Lake__STM Tartrazine Lake new without micro.txt:30

openQuestions.question: Microbiological limits: the spec sheet reads 'NMT 103 CFU / gm' and 'NMT 102 CFU / gm' (superscript lost); read as 10^3 = 1000 and 10^2 = 100 CFU/g. Confirm. The micro methods are only referenced to SOP C2I-91-128, which is not in this STM.
